facts.fact: Ma 备下炒蛋、浇自家蜂蜜的粥、煎面包、煎番茄、焗豆当无声的祝福；Miriam 胃里拧紧只能硬吃
facts.anchor: that hearty breakfast was Ma’s unspoken blessing

facts.fact: Pamela 帮 Miriam 别出“职业感”发型、刷净裤子熨好衬衫擦亮平底鞋，并用指尖把口红点进她双颊代替胭脂
facts.anchor: she worked dabs of lipstick into my cheeks with the tip of her finger

facts.fact: Whipple 借围裙尺寸脱口叫她 Mimi，随即摇头纠正回 Miriam
facts.anchor: ‘Frank’s apron will be far too big for you, Mimi.’ He shook his head.

facts.fact: Miriam 第一次走进老宅内部便立刻爱上：表面闲适底下藏着对称平衡的严规，Doris 的尺子保证餐盘等距、刀叉离桌沿一拇指宽
facts.anchor: It was the first time I’d gone further than the hall

facts.fact: Harold 粉脸冒汗、酒红缎晨袍松垮、赤脚走进阁楼客房，坐上双人床抓着肚皮
facts.anchor: wearing a burgundy satin dressing-gown, loosely tied, his feet bare

facts.fact: Harold 自称 Miriam 能留下全靠他替她在 Celia 面前争了情面，并停下来等她道谢；她开不了口
Harold 大谈 Lawrence 需要挨拳、去 Feathers 灌酒、滚干草堆的粗粝教育，并以“Rushwood 的事留在 Rushwood”收尾
facts.anchor: what happens at Rushwood stays at Rushwood, Miriam.

facts.fact: Doris 抱着一摞叠好的床单出现在门口，笑着说“Miriam, you’re needed downstairs”，把她从 Harold 面前叫走
facts.anchor: Doris appeared in the doorway, smiling cheerfully, taking in everything, betraying nothing, a stack of folded sheets in her arms.
